delivery.readyWithin: Ready to collect within {{days}} business days

state.error: The order could not be calculated.
state.offline: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
state.emptyCart: Your cart is empty, so there is nothing to pay for.
state.unauthenticated: Sign in to complete your order.
state.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then refresh the page.
state.emailNotVerified: Verify your email address before completing this order. We sent a verification link when you registered — check your inbox, including the spam folder.

blocked.heading: This order cannot be completed
blocked.intro: These products cannot be bought right now. Update or remove them in the cart.
blocked.WITHDRAWN: This product is no longer sold. Remove it.
blocked.SOLD_OUT: This product is sold out. Remove it.
blocked.SHORT_STOCK: Only {{available}} left in stock. Lower the quantity to {{available}}.

address.noSavedAddress: No address is saved on your account, so please enter one here.
address.unavailable: We could not load your saved details. You can enter them here.

pay.simulated: Simulated payment — nothing is charged and no card details are collected.
pay.saveAddress: Save this address for next time

done.heading: Order received
done.replayed: This order was already placed. This is a repeat confirmation, not a second charge.

payFailure.declined: The payment was declined. No order was placed, your cart is unchanged, and you can try again.
payFailure.changed: The details changed since they were shown. These are the updated figures — please confirm them again.
payFailure.orderCancelled: Order {{number}} was cancelled. Start a new checkout to order again.
payFailure.addressRejected: That address does not suit the delivery method you chose.
payFailure.invalidRequest: Something in the request was wrong ({{code}}). That is a fault on our side — reload the page and try again.
payFailure.offline: The connection dropped before we heard back. Your order may still have gone through — press Confirm and pay again; it cannot create a second order.
payFailure.orderCancelledUnnamed: That earlier order was cancelled. Start a new checkout to order again.

card.notice: Demo form. Nothing is charged, and the card details are never sent to the server or stored anywhere.
card.WRONG_LENGTH_number: A card number has between 13 and 19 digits.
card.FAILS_CHECKSUM: That card number is not valid. Check the digits.
